answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where agents secure a vertex of the network through locked capital. By requiring a financial quill to sign blocks, the protocol ensures that creating fake identities demands proportional resource acquisition. The economic tide of this system forces an attacker to purchase a majority of the circulating supply, imposing a cost that scales linearly with network influence, thereby rendering mass-identity fabrication prohibitively expensive.
